description: Address code quality issues from semantic review: deduplicate noSmartPlans array, coerce age once, switch innerHTML to textContent, and re-validate curJalan on product switch.
steps: 1. Extract triplicated noSmartPlans logic into a single getNoSmartPlans(produk) function.
2. Coerce curUsia to a string once in setUsia instead of repeating String(usia) at every lookup site.
3. Replace innerHTML fallback message in recalc() with textContent to prevent future XSS risk.
4. Re-validate curJalan on product switch, mirroring how curGigi is handled.
acceptance_criteria: Only one definition of the no-Smart-plans list exists (single function or constant)
curUsia is stored as a string after setUsia; no String() calls remain at lookup sites
The fallback message in recalc uses textContent (no innerHTML for user-visible strings)
On product switch, curJalan is re-validated against the new product's rider data availability
verification: Verify the inline script has no syntax errors via Node.js function constructor check
Verify sample calculation still works: Syariah PRIA age 0 Diamond = 42551900
findings: All 4 review issues addressed. Syntax verified via Node.js Function constructor. Sample calculation verified: sya_inap P 0 Diamond = 42551900 (correct). No remaining String(usia) calls at lookup sites. getNoSmartPlans() is now the single source of truth for plan-Smart availability.
